About Us:

Solytics Partners is a Global Analytics firm, recognized with multiple industry awards for innovation and excellence. Our team comprises experts with deep domain knowledge in risk, analytics, AI/ML, AML/FCC, and fraud. By converging this expertise with cutting-edge technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs), we deliver powerful automated platforms and incisive point solutions.Our offerings enable clients to streamline and future-proof their risk, AML, and analytics processes, comply seamlessly with global regulations, and safeguard financial systems. Whether its solving complex challenges or driving operational efficiency, Solytics Partners is committed to empowering organizations with transformative tools to stay ahead in an evolving regulatory landscape.

Role Summary:

We are looking for a strong, hands-on AI Architect to define and drive the architecture of AI-powered products and solutions within a product engineering environment. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, System Design, and Solution Architecture, with a proven track record of taking AI initiatives from business problem definition and PoCs through production deployment and scale.This role will work closely with Product Managers, Data Scientists, AI/ML Engineers, and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, high-performance AI solutions. The AI Architect will provide technical direction to a team of Data Science and AI/ML Engineers, establish architectural best practices, evaluate emerging AI technologies, and ensure that AI solutions are practical, production-ready, and aligned with product and business goals.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Understand complex business and product requirements and translate them into end-to-end AI/ML and GenAI solution architectures.
  • Own AI solution architecture and system design from concept through production.
  • Design scalable architectures covering models/LLMs, data pipelines, APIs, integrations, retrieval systems, cloud infrastructure, security, monitoring, and deployment.
  • Lead the development of PoCs, prototypes, and MVPs to validate AI use cases and establish technical feasibility.
  • Design and guide implementation of GenAI, RAG, LLM and Agentic AI solutions.
  • Work closely with Data Scientists and AI/ML Engineers to convert architectural designs into robust, production-ready implementations.
  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to a team of 10+ AI/ML and Data Science engineers.
  • Review technical designs, identify architectural gaps, and drive engineering best practices across AI initiatives.
  • Make informed decisions around model selection, architecture patterns, technology choices, scalability, latency, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and implement integrations using APIs, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Ensure AI solutions meet organizational requirements around security, privacy, compliance, scalability, performance, and reliability.
  • Identify reusable AI components, frameworks, accelerators, and architecture patterns to improve engineering efficiency.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/GenAI technologies and assess their practical applicability to product use cases.
  • Create and maintain architecture diagrams, solution designs, technical documentation, and architecture decision records.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to define the technical roadmap for AI/GenAI capabilities.
  • Help take successful PoCs into production-grade, scalable AI products.

Must-Have Technical Skills:AI Architecture & System Design

  • Proven experience designing end-to-end AI/ML or GenAI solutions.
  • Strong understanding of System Design, Solution Architecture, and architectural design patterns.
  • Experience translating business/product requirements into technical architecture.
  • Ability to make architecture and technology decisions independently.

GenAI / LLM / RAG:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
  • Solid experience designing and implementing RAG architectures.
  • Good understanding of embeddings, vector search/databases, retrieval, prompting, context management, and LLM integration.
  • Practical exposure to Agentic AI / AI Agents is highly desirable.
  • Experience with one or more relevant GenAI frameworks/platforms is expected.

Hands-on Engineering:

  • Strong Python programming experience.
  • Experience working with REST APIs, microservices, integrations, and distributed systems.
  • Ability to build and technically validate AI PoCs/MVPs.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles and production development practices.

Cloud & Production Architecture:

  • Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience designing and deploying cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Experience taking AI solutions from PoC/MVP to production.
  • Understanding of scalability, performance, reliability, observability, deployment, and cost optimization.

Leadership & Collaboration:

  • Proven experience providing technical leadership to AI/ML or engineering teams.
  • Ability to mentor and guide Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and AI Engineers.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and product/business stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in a product-driven, fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to balance technical excellence with business value, time-to-market, scalability, and cost.

What We Are Looking For:We are looking for someone who has real-world ownership of AI architecture, not just exposure to AI technologies.

The ideal candidate should be able to demonstrate examples where they have:


  • Understood a business problem designed the AI solution created/led a PoC made architecture decisions guided engineering implementation taken the solution to production scaled and improved it.
  • Candidates with strong Senior AI Engineer / Lead AI Engineer / AI Solution Architect / AI Architect / GenAI Architect backgrounds are encouraged to apply, provided they have demonstrated hands-on architecture and production ownership.

Preferred Background:

  • 68 years of overall experience in AI/ML, software engineering, or related technology roles.
  • Strong combination of hands-on engineering + AI expertise + architecture ownership.
  • Experience working in a product-based organization or building customer-facing/product-grade AI solutions is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with cross-functional Product, Engineering, Data Science, and AI teams.
  • Proven experience delivering AI solutions that operate at production scale.

We are looking for a technically strong AI Architect who can design, build, challenge, guide, and scale real AI solutions while providing technical direction to a growing AI/ML engineering team.

This is a hybrid role: you will act as a trusted advisor to internal business leaders and external clients on AI risk, governance and secure adoption, while also rolling up your sleeves to red-team LLM applications, assess AI pipelines and define the security architecture for our AI platforms.

You will be the security voice in the room when new AI use cases are scoped, the person the delivery teams call when an agent needs to touch production data, and the expert clients trust to tell them what "secure AI" actually means in practice.

Key Responsibilities

AI Security Advisory & Client Engagement

  • Serve as the lead security advisor on AI engagements for internal business units and enterprise clients, translating AI risk into clear, business-relevant recommendations for CISOs, CIOs, CDOs and product leadership.
  • Define and drive the AI security strategy and roadmap for the AI CoE, aligned to enterprise security policy, regulatory obligations and business objectives.
  • Lead AI risk assessments and security reviews of proposed use cases, third-party AI products, foundation-model providers and internally built AI solutions; own the go / no-go security recommendation.
  • Support pre-sales and solutioning: shape AI security service offerings, contribute to proposals and RFP responses, scope engagements, estimate effort and present at client workshops and executive briefings.
  • Establish and maintain the AI security governance framework policies, standards, control libraries, review gates and approval workflows mapped to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 27001, the EU AI Act and applicable regional regulations.
  • Act as the primary security liaison between the AI CoE and Enterprise Security, Risk & Compliance, Legal, Privacy and Data Governance functions.

Hands-on AI Security Engineering & Testing

  • Plan and execute AI red-teaming and adversarial testing of LLM applications, RAG pipelines, copilots and agentic systems prompt injection (direct and indirect), jailbreaks, data exfiltration, tool/function-call abuse, excessive agency, model and system-prompt extraction, and training-data poisoning.
  • Perform threat modelling for AI architectures (STRIDE / MITRE ATLAS / OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications), covering models, orchestration layers, vector stores, agent frameworks, MCP/tool integrations, plug-ins and data pipelines.
  • Design and validate secure MLOps / LLMOps practices: model provenance and supply-chain integrity, model registry security, secrets and key management, secure fine-tuning and evaluation pipelines, artefact signing and SBOM/AI-BOM.
  • Define and implement AI guardrails and runtime controls – input/output filtering, content moderation, PII/DLP controls, rate limiting, policy enforcement and AI firewall / gateway patterns – and integrate them with existing SOC monitoring, SIEM and incident response.
  • Build and maintain automated AI security testing tooling (e.g., Garak, PyRIT, Promptfoo, custom harnesses) and integrate security evaluation into CI/CD for AI products.
  • Conduct security reviews of cloud AI services and platforms (Azure OpenAI / AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, Google Vertex AI, Databricks) including identity, network isolation, data residency and logging configurations.
  • Lead incident response for AI-specific security events – model abuse, data leakage via AI, compromised agents – and drive root-cause analysis and remediation.

Leadership, Enablement & Thought Leadership

  • Mentor and technically lead a pod of security consultants and engineers; review deliverables and uphold quality standards across AI security engagements.
  • Develop and deliver AI security training and awareness programmes for developers, data scientists, product owners and executives; create secure-AI development guidelines and reference architectures.
  • Contribute to thought leadership – whitepapers, conference talks, internal communities of practice and industry working groups – and keep the organisation ahead of the evolving AI threat landscape.
  • Track and evaluate emerging AI security research, tools and regulation; advise on adoption and update standards accordingly.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity, including at least 5 years in a consulting, advisory or security-architecture capacity with direct client or senior-stakeholder exposure.
  • 2–3+ years of hands-on experience securing AI/ML or generative-AI systems – LLM application security testing, AI red-teaming, ML pipeline security or AI governance implementation in a production environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 27001/27002 and the EU AI Act; ability to map these to practical, testable controls.
  • Deep technical foundations across application security, cloud security (at least one of Azure, AWS or GCP), identity & access management, data protection, and DevSecOps.
  • Practical understanding of LLM and GenAI architectures – transformers, embeddings, RAG, fine-tuning, agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen), MCP and tool/function calling – and their security implications.
  • Proficiency in Python and comfort reading and writing code to build test harnesses, automate assessments and review AI application code.
  • Proven experience leading threat modelling, penetration testing or red-team engagements and producing executive-grade reports and remediation roadmaps.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation and influencing skills – able to present complex technical risk to C-level audiences and to challenge stakeholders constructively.
  • Experience working in a large, matrixed multinational environment, across time zones, cultures and regulatory jurisdictions.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, GIAC (GCPN / GWAPT / GCTI), cloud security specialty certifications, or emerging AI-focused credentials (e.g., ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, IAPP AIGP).
  • Master's degree in Cybersecurity, AI/ML, Data Science or related discipline.
  • Experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (differential privacy, federated learning, confidential computing) and model-level attacks/defences (membership inference, model inversion, adversarial examples, data poisoning).
  • Familiarity with AI security and governance tooling (e.g., Microsoft Purview / Defender for AI, Lakera, Protect AI, Robust Intelligence, HiddenLayer, Credo AI, IBM watsonx.governance).
  • Published research, open-source contributions, CTF/red-team achievements or conference presentations in AI security.
  • Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, telecommunications or public sector.

  • Strategic thinking with technical depth – equally comfortable defining a multi-year AI security roadmap and demonstrating a prompt-injection exploit live.
  • Risk-based judgement – balances innovation velocity against security and regulatory obligations, and knows when to say "yes, with conditions".
  • Stakeholder management and executive presence – builds trust with business, technology and client leadership.
  • Ownership and delivery focus – drives engagements end-to-end with high quality under tight timelines.
  • Continuous learning – keeps pace with a field where the threat landscape changes monthly.

Avalara's Marketing Technology team is scaling its execution capabilities and expanding its AI capabilities to keep pace with a growing go-to-market engine. The systems that power campaign execution, lead lifecycle management, and marketing operations, Workfront, Marketo, and our leads pipeline, require strong, hands-on technical talent to build, maintain, and continuously improve them.

This IC4 MarTech Engineer role is for a strong technical leader who can transition marketing capabilities from a digital marketing paradigm to an agentic marketing approach by integrating, automating, and configuring new agentic models and solutions across our enterprise capabilities, building reliable integrations, automating marketing workflows, and ensuring lead data flows accurately from capture to CRM handoff.

  • Build and maintain integrations between Marketo, Salesforce CRM, Workfront, and adjacent MarTech systems, delivering reliable, well-documented solutions.

  • Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability
  • Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.

  • Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
  • Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

AI Expectations


Avalara is an AI-first company. This role is expected to be an AI Bar Raiser, not a casual user of AI tools, but someone who embeds AI into how MarTech work gets done and elevates the AI capability of the team.

Specifically, this role is expected to:

  • Use AI to accelerate development and troubleshooting, including AI-assisted code generation, API debugging, and automated testing for MarTech integrations.
  • Apply AI to lead intelligence, leveraging AI/ML-based lead scoring and intent signal processing to improve pipeline quality and Sales efficiency.
  • Automate content and campaign operations using AI tools to reduce manual effort in asset creation, QA, and campaign setup within Marketo and Workfront.
  • Identify and quantify AI-driven improvements, e.g., reduction in lead processing time, improvement in MQL-to-SQL conversion, or hours saved through intelligent workflow automation.
  • Share AI best practices with the MarTech team and Marketing Operations, helping peers adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
  • Apply AI responsibly, with awareness of data privacy, governance, and ethical use standards relevant to marketing data and customer information.

About Steelbazaar

Steelbazaar is a B2B steel marketplace connecting buyers and sellers across the steel value chain, bringing transparency, efficiency, and technology to how steel is bought, sold, and delivered. We're building the data and AI backbone that powers pricing intelligence, matching, and automation across the platform.


About the role

We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineering Manager to build and lead a small, high-impact team responsible for Steelbazaar's AI/ML capabilities end to end — from marketplace intelligence (pricing, demand-supply matching, search and recommendations, credit/fraud risk scoring) to GenAI-powered products (RFQ and document parsing, AI-assisted quoting, customer support copilots) and, where relevant, computer vision for material and quality inspection. This role owns the AI platform broadly: the data foundations, MLOps infrastructure, and the applied AI teams that ship models into production.

You'll split your time between people leadership, technical architecture, and staying close enough to the code and models to make good calls with your team.


What you'll do

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 3–6 AI/ML engineers, setting technical direction, running performance reviews, and hiring as the team scales.
  • Own the AI/ML roadmap across marketplace intelligence (pricing forecasting, demand-supply matching, search/recommendations, fraud and credit risk models), GenAI products (chatbots, RFQ/document parsing, AI-assisted quoting, internal copilots), and computer vision use cases (material and quality inspection, inventory/logistics automation) as priorities dictate.
  • Design and oversee the data platform and MLOps infrastructure needed to build, deploy, monitor, and retrain models reliably in production — feature stores, pipelines, model registries, CI/CD for ML, observability.
  • Partner closely with Product, Data Engineering, and business stakeholders (sales, operations, supply chain) to translate business problems into AI solutions and prioritize the roadmap.
  • Stay hands-on: review architecture and code, get into notebooks or production issues when needed, and set engineering standards for model development, evaluation, and deployment.

  • Establish practices for responsible AI — data privacy, model bias/fairness checks, and human-in-the-loop safeguards where relevant.
  • Report on AI initiative outcomes and ROI to leadership, and communicate technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.

  • 10+ years in software/ML engineering, including 5+ years directly managing or leading an engineering/ML team.

  • Experience with at least two of: recommendation/ranking systems, time-series forecasting, NLP/LLM applications, computer vision, or risk/fraud scoring models.
  • Practical experience integrating LLMs into products (prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, or agentic workflows) is a strong plus given our GenAI roadmap.
  • Comfortable working with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and modern data stacks (Spark, Airflow, dbt, or similar).

  • Strong communication skills; able to work directly with business and product teams in a fast-moving marketplace environment.
  • Prior experience in B2B marketplaces, e-commerce, fintech, or industrial/manufacturing domains is a plus, but not required.

What we offer

  • Ownership of AI strategy and execution in a fast-growing B2B marketplace.
  • A small, focused team where your technical decisions have direct, visible business impact.

Our Global Government & Public Sector (GPS) is a network of highly skilled professionals dedicated to serving our clients by bringing best-in-class international experience and insight combined with local knowledge to solve the most critical problems facing governments today. Digital transformation is not just about new technologies; it involves an overhaul of organizational structures, governance, work processes, culture and mindset. It also means realizing a wider vision of relationships and business models that will redesign how public services function.
To achieve this vision, we help clients balance strategic choices to re-ignite performance. We have developed a suite of cross-service line strategic solutions that align with our client priorities.
We have a proud record of helping governments meet their challenges head-on, and we work closely with them to build a world that works better for all citizens.

EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
Business Consulting works with clients to reimagine or transform their business purpose and model; create growth; manage cost and efficiency; respond to market pressures and regulation; and resolve operational challenges. The scope of this team encompasses innovation, strategy and purpose, through deep functional experience in business transformation, finance, supply chain and operations, providing support for the complex and large-scale program and portfolio management.
It has multiple fields of play such as:
Finance Consulting - helps assess and transform our clients' finance function to improve performance and effectiveness. We help organizations implement service and cost improvement initiatives, and embed a performance management process and culture that unites the business around its core objectives.
Business Transformation - a multidisciplinary competency, gathering capabilities in transformation architecture, experience design, business design and transformation execution to problem-solve, design and deliver large scale, multi-year, multi-stakeholder transformation programs.
Supply Chain and Operations - we provide a unique combination of industry-specific, strategic, operational and financial insights, digital technology advances and strategic alliance partners to deliver better outcomes and also help clients effect fundamental change in their operations performance to support sales growth, become more cost competitive, minimize risk and ensure operational resilience.

  • Strong ability to support business consulting engagements with structured analysis and problem-solving across transformation initiatives.
  • Proficient in client management activities, including coordination, requirement capture, and issue tracking throughout delivery cycles.
  • Experienced in preparing clear, accurate documentation such as process notes, status updates, and deliverable summaries.
  • Capable of contributing to transformation delivery efforts by organizing data, tracking actions, and maintaining project discipline.

  • Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science

Job Title: GDS Alliances Program Operations Lead Analyst
Job Summary
The GDS Global Ecosystem Enablement Program Lead Analyst will function as a key program operations and enablement resource within the GDS Partner Operations CoE, supporting the Global Ecosystem Enablement team and the broader EY Partner Ecosystem program. The role will help operationalize scalable alliance enablement services across strategic initiatives, business-as-usual operations, process improvement, knowledge management, stakeholder communications and leadership reporting. Working closely with onshore alliance leaders, GDS enablement teams and cross-functional stakeholders, the incumbent will support the design, execution and continuous improvement of operating models, governance cadences, collaboration mechanisms and service delivery processes that strengthen global ecosystem execution. The role requires strong program management discipline, analytical orientation, executive communication capability and a service excellence mindset to translate complex partner ecosystem priorities into structured plans, clear deliverables and measurable outcomes. The incumbent will also contribute to special projects, strategic initiatives, process standardization, automation opportunities, content development and issue resolution, ensuring that Global Ecosystem Enablement priorities are delivered with consistency, agility and high professional quality across geographies.
Essential Functions of the Job
  • Program manage priority initiatives for the Global Ecosystem Enablement function, including operating model enhancements, governance cadences, service delivery improvements, stakeholder communications, leadership reporting, tool adoption and cross-functional execution support.
  • Support the design, deployment and ongoing management of scalable partner ecosystem operations across the GDS Partner Operations CoE, ensuring that processes, roles, responsibilities, escalation paths and service expectations are clearly defined and consistently executed.
  • Act as a subject matter resource on Global Ecosystem Enablement processes, tools, documentation and operating rhythms, serving as a first point of contact for queries, issue triage, resolution coordination and stakeholder guidance.
  • Drive continuous process improvement by assessing current-state workflows, identifying pain points, eliminating duplication, simplifying handoffs, standardizing repeatable activities and recommending practical improvements that increase efficiency, quality, speed and stakeholder experience.
  • Identify and support opportunities for intelligent automation and AI-enabled productivity improvements, including use cases for workflow automation, knowledge retrieval, content generation, reporting support, data validation, process tracking, meeting productivity and self-service guidance.
  • Partner with onshore alliance leaders, GDS enablement teams, technology teams and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business priorities into structured workplans, clear milestones, decision points, risks, dependencies and measurable outcomes.
  • Build, maintain and continuously refresh process documentation, playbooks, operating guides, stakeholder overviews, leadership summaries, templates and best-practice repositories to enable consistent global execution and knowledge continuity.
  • Convert complex partner ecosystem processes, requirements and updates into clear, user-friendly communications, guidance notes, executive-ready summaries, training materials, process maps and stakeholder-facing content.
  • Manage the structured review and refresh cadence for Global Ecosystem Enablement reference materials, ensuring content accuracy, version control, access management, SharePoint hygiene, ownership clarity and timely updates across relevant platforms.
  • Support data-driven operations by consolidating inputs, tracking progress, monitoring key operational metrics, preparing insights, highlighting trends and developing leadership-ready dashboards, reports and performance summaries.
  • Coordinate collaboration across enablement workstreams, geographies and stakeholder groups to create stronger connection points, improve transparency, reduce execution friction and ensure alignment on priorities, timelines and outcomes.
  • Support internal EY ecosystem leadership meetings, governance forums and stakeholder reviews by developing agendas, pre-read materials, executive content, decision logs, action trackers, follow-up notes and logistics support.
  • Program manage special projects and strategic initiatives across the partner ecosystem landscape, including process standardization, tool/process enhancements, knowledge management, budget tracking, communications planning, stakeholder engagement and change adoption.
  • Manage onshore stakeholder expectations through proactive communication, structured planning, disciplined follow-through, timely escalation of risks and delivery of high-quality outputs aligned to agreed timelines and priorities.
  • Contribute to the maturity of the GDS Partner Operations CoE by identifying repeatable service opportunities, codifying delivery standards, improving operational controls, strengthening service measurement and helping scale high-value alliance enablement capabilities across geographies.
Knowledge and Skill Requirements
  • Strong ability to support and program manage strategic projects, special initiatives and transformation priorities in a complex global partner ecosystem environment, with the discipline to translate ambiguous business priorities into structured workplans, milestones, governance routines, risks, dependencies and measurable outcomes.
  • Demonstrated stakeholder management capability, including the ability to work confidently with senior onshore stakeholders, alliance leaders, GDS teams and cross-functional groups; build trusted advisor relationships; influence without authority; and manage expectations through proactive, clear and solution-oriented communication.
  • Sound understanding of alliance, partner ecosystem, sales enablement or partner operations environments, including awareness of partner programs, operating models, governance forums, pipeline and opportunity life cycles, stakeholder reporting, partner tools, knowledge repositories and enablement processes.
  • Strong project and initiative management skills across planning, execution, tracking, risk management, action management, budget coordination, benefits tracking, stakeholder reviews and closure reporting, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and aggressive timelines without compromising quality.
  • Contemporary AI fluency with the ability to identify practical AI-enabled use cases for productivity improvement, content development, reporting support, workflow tracking, data validation, knowledge retrieval, meeting productivity, self-service guidance and operational insight generation.
  • Ability to apply AI responsibly within enterprise policies and guardrails, including awareness of data privacy, confidentiality, information security, accuracy validation, human review, appropriate prompt design and responsible use of generative AI tools in a professional services environment.
  • Strong continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to assess current-state processes, conduct root-cause analysis, identify inefficiencies, remove duplication, simplify handoffs, standardize repeatable activities and recommend pragmatic improvements that improve speed, quality, consistency and stakeholder experience.
  • Working knowledge of process improvement and operational excellence concepts such as process mapping, standard operating procedures, service catalogues, RACI models, controls, SLAs, KPIs, Lean thinking, change adoption and benefits realization.

Job Summary

The Lead Data Platform Agentic AI Engineer will design and build core platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable GenAI and Agentic AI solutions across Bread Financial. This role will develop foundational services such as, agent orchestration, vector search, LLM interfaces, and observability and security frameworks that allow product teams to deliver reliable AI features quickly and safely. The Lead Engineer will work closely with platform, security, and application teams, ensuring AI platform components are production-ready, well-governed, and aligned to enterprise standards. The Lead Engineer will apply strong technical judgement, contribute to platform design decisions, and help evolve shared AI infrastructure that accelerates innovation while maintaining trust, reliability, and compliance.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design and build orchestration layers for LLM workflows and multi-step agent pipelines (tool use, retrieval, grounding, function calling), with clear SLAs, retries, rate limiting, and tracing. - (20%)
  • Implement vector data infrastructure (e.g. Chroma, OpenSearch) including indexing strategies, embeddings management, RAG patterns, and data lifecycle controls. - (15%)
  • Develop LLM interfaces & SDKs that abstract providers (Bedrock, Azure/OpenAI, etc.), standardize prompts, enable guardrails, and support evaluation harnesses and A/B testing. - (15%)
  • Integrate logging, tracing (e.g., OpenTelemetry), metrics, prompt/response analytics, eval pipelines (quality, toxicity, hallucination), and SLO dashboards. - (10%)
  • Enforce data classification, redaction, PII controls, prompt injection defenses, content filtering, secrets management, and policy-as-code for model/endpoint access. - (10%)
  • IaC (Terraform/CDK), CI/CD for model and prompt artifacts, environment promotion, and cost monitoring/optimization. - (10%)
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (data engineering, security, product) to productionize new capabilities and drive platform adoption through documentation, templates, and enablement. - (10%)
  • Participate in on-call rotations, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement of performance, reliability, and developer experience. - (10%)

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field of study or equivalent, relevant work experience
  • 8+ years of overall software engineering experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building AI platform components.
  • 4+ years of experience implementing LLM-based services: prompt templates, tool/function calling, retrieval-augmented generation, and rate/latency management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Masters Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field of study or equivalent, relevant work experience
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification.
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience.
  • 4+ years of experience building AI platform components.
  • 4+ years of experience implementing LLM-based services: prompt templates, tool/function calling, retrieval-augmented generation, and rate/latency management.

The opportunity
We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable and production-ready enterprise AI solutions. The role combines hands-on architecture with consulting leadership across Generative AI, Agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI/ML, cloud platforms and modern application engineering. The architect will translate business priorities into target-state architectures, reusable patterns and implementation roadmaps while guiding multidisciplinary teams from discovery through deployment and operationalization.
The ideal candidate has delivered enterprise or client-facing AI solutions in pre-production or production environments and can explain the use case, architecture, personal contribution, controls, delivery approach and outcomes. Certifications, personal projects and demonstrations alone are not sufficient.
Your key responsibilities
  • Lead discovery and architecture workshops, clarify business outcomes and non-functional requirements, and convert them into scalable AI solution designs and delivery roadmaps.
  • Architect LLM applications, copilots, RAG and Graph RAG solutions, autonomous agents, multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, memory patterns and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Define reference architectures and reusable patterns for document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, grounding, prompt workflows, model routing and enterprise integrations.
  • Select fit-for-purpose models, cloud services, vector stores, orchestration frameworks and evaluation approaches based on security, quality, latency, cost, scalability and maintainability requirements.
  • Design API-first, event-driven and microservices-based integrations with enterprise applications, data platforms, workflow systems and user experience layers.

  • Define cloud-native deployment and operations patterns using containers, Kubernetes or managed services, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, model/LLM operations, monitoring and release controls.
  • Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, code reviews and production-readiness assessments; troubleshoot complex issues and guide performance optimization.

  • Understanding of ML, deep learning, NLP, predictive analytics and the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, MLOps, LLMOps, observability and production support.

EY GDS Risk Consulting is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge.
EYs MENA Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) team, part of the EY GDS Risk Consulting Practice, delivers tailored risk solutions to help clients identify, assess, manage, and monitor a range of financial and regulatory risks. The division is ideal for collaborative individuals who have strong ethics and attention to detail.
Within FSRM, the Credit Risk (CR) team focuses on supporting clientsranging from large domestic banks to global financial institutionsin implementing strategic, functional, and regulatory transformations across credit risk management within their banking book portfolios.
You will work within different sized, multi-disciplinary teams and play a key role in ensuring high quality outputs and service to our clients. The role involves developing knowledge and implementing new solutions to meet the ever-changing needs of our clients. We value intellectual curiosity and a passion for promoting solutions across organizational boundaries.

  • Lead a team of 5-6 Senior consultants, analysts for engagement execution and delivery. You will also spend teaming up with industry professionals to develop and deliver a wide range of risk management strategies and solutions
  • Showcase exceptional project management abilities and foster a collaborative environment and accountability among team members on engagements
  • Demonstrate deep technical expertise and industry knowledge, particularly in financial products with a focus on lending solutions.

  • Adapt to projects involving model audits, validation, and development, demonstrating flexibility and domain knowledge

  • Solid understanding of Risk analytics methodologies.

  • Strong documentation skills, with the ability to quickly grasp complex concepts and present them clearly in documents or presentations.

  • Knowledge of regulatory modeling (BASEL, CCAR, IF) is preferred
  • Exposure to regulatory stress testing processes around credit risk & ICAAP
  • Experience in climatic risk space preferably in the areas of stress testing /scenario designing
  • Exposure to Interest Rate Risk in Banking Book (IRRBB)
  • Experience in data/business intelligence (BI) reporting.
  • Familiarity with machine learning models and their practical applications.
  • Prior project management experience
  • Willingness to travel for client engagements

jobDescription:
Job Summary
As part of our EY-ER- Regulatory Compliance team, you will help the clients by understanding their business needs and delivering solutions in accordance with the EY guidelines & methodologies. As a Regulatory Compliance Manager actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. In line with our commitment to quality, youll consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives.
The opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in Laboratory Digitalisation to lead regulatory strategy and IT-enabled transformation initiatives in regulated GxP environments. This role requires strong consulting skills, industry knowledge, and the ability to translate regulatory strategy into scalable, compliant solutions for global clients.
Role Overview
As a Manager at Regulatory Compliance, you will lead Digital Laboratory initiatives in regulated GxP environments, leveraging your deep expertise in Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Electronic Laboratory Notebooks (ELN), Laboratory Execution Systems (LES), and strong consulting capabilities.
Your primary responsibility will be to partner with clients to understand their laboratory business needs and translate strategic objectives into integrated, compliant, and practical digital lab solutions. You will play a pivotal role in establishing and nurturing relationships across internal teams and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment with EY's commitment to data integrity, quality, and regulatory compliance.
This is a leadership role that demands strategic thinking, strong stakeholder engagement, and a passion for delivering excellence across complex laboratory operations in a highly regulated environment.
Your key responsibilities Client Responsibilities
  • Lead and oversee Digital Lab initiatives, including LIMS, ELN, and LES implementations, upgrades, and optimizations in regulated laboratory environments
  • Configure and customize LIMS platforms (LabWare, Benchling, STARLIMS) to support end-to-end laboratory workflows including sample lifecycle management, testing, stability studies, and reporting.
  • Design and implement master data, workflows, and business rules (e.g., specifications, test methods, instruments, calculations) aligned with GxP requirements and regulatory standards.
  • Develop integrations and data interfaces between LIMS and enterprise systems (e.g., CDS, ELN, ERP, MES) using APIs, middleware, or flat-file exchanges to enable seamless data flow.
  • Support validation and compliance activities by preparing configuration documentation, executing IQ/OQ/PQ, and ensuring adherence to 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize system performance by resolving configuration issues, enhancing usability, and driving continuous improvement initiatives across laboratory operations.
  • Partner with clients to understand laboratory operations and translate business and compliance requirements into integrated digital lab solutions and their respective configurations
  • Drive requirements gathering, system configuration, data migration, and integrations across lab systems, instruments, and enterprise platforms
  • Ensure data integrity, traceability, and compliance with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and internal SOPs
  • Guide clients through CSV / CSA / risk based validation activities for digital lab systems
  • Support audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments related to laboratory systems
  • Identify opportunities for process harmonization, standardization, and digital enablement across laboratories
People Responsibilities
  • Lead, coach, and mentor Digital Lab consultants, validation analysts, and technical team members
  • Manage work allocation across LIMS, ELN, and LES engagements, ensuring quality delivery and adherence to timelines
  • Conduct performance reviews, feedback, and development planning
  • Build and strengthen Digital Lab and laboratory systems capabilities within the team
  • Support hiring, onboarding, training, and knowledge transfer initiatives
  • Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement
Decision-Making Responsibilities
  • Make informed decisions on delivery approach, validation strategy, and risk mitigation for digital lab programs
  • Assess system, data, and compliance risks and proactively escalate issues to clients and EY leadership
  • Support leadership in workforce planning, solution design, and practice development for Digital Lab offerings
  • Guide decisions on vendor coordination, system design tradeoffs, and implementation timelines
  • Apply structured and analytical thinking to improve delivery efficiency and client outcomes.
Other Responsibilities
  • Contribute to business development, proposals, and client presentations related to Digital Lab initiatives
  • Support inspection readiness, mock audits, and CAPA activities
  • Stay current with regulatory expectations, industry trends, and emerging digital lab technologies
  • Promote adoption of automation, analytics, and innovation within laboratory operations
  • Collaborate with Quality, IT, Regulatory, and Manufacturing teams to deliver integrated solutions
  • Uphold EY's standards for ethics, quality, and compliance.
Skills and attributes for success
  • Strong understanding of regulated laboratory environments and quality-driven operations
  • Ability to identify process gaps, operational risks, and improvement opportunities
  • Structured and analytical approach to problem-solving

Industry convergence offers TMT (Technology, Media & Entertainment, and Telecommunications) organizations the chance to evolve and transform, but it also presents challenges around competitiveness and delivering agile corporate strategies for growth. CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.

  • Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.

The Factory Information Architect will ensure that the required enterprise capabilities, governance mechanisms, and technology solutions exist to catalog, manage, contextualize, validate, and monitor these standards at scale. The role must understand the relevant technologies sufficiently to define practical requirements and guide delivery teams, but is not expected to build pipelines or platforms directly.
